back:
No. Each variable is initialized only by its own initializer.

int a, b = 5;   // a has no initializer — default-initialized (garbage for int). Only b is 5.
int a = 5, b = 5;   // both 5

Define one variable per line to avoid this.
front: If you write int a, b = 5; is a initialized to 5? Why or why not?
